```yaml
name: PR Size Labeler

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  pr-size-labeler:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Label PR based on size
        uses: actions/labeler@v6
        with:
          repo-token: "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"
          configuration-path: .github/labeler.yml
          sync-labels: true
```

yaml:
name: PR Size Labeler

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  pr-size-labeler:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Label PR based on size
        uses: actions/labeler@v6
        with:
          repo-token: "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"
          configuration-path: .github/labeler.yml
          sync-labels: true
